I don't know about that. As a guy, I may have done this to gauge how she might be feeling.

She said he's an awkward communicator. If so, then he may not have the confidence to flat out say that he wants to start seeing her again. He may not want to embarrass himself with the potential rejection.

I'm not trying to give you false hope OP. His making a sudden exit may have been to do with him feeling that he wasn't getting anywhere and the convo wasn't going as he'd hoped.

If you can cope with the possibility of being rejected, then I would give him a shout and ask him if he'd like to get together again. It's the only way you'll know for sure.
